description: This file provides utility functions for accounting-related operations in the OFBiz framework, such as retrieving accounts, checking account types, navigating account and invoice hierarchies, and calculating exchange rates.

classes.name: UtilAccounting
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for various accounting-related operations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getProductOrgGlAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the GL account ID for a product or the default account for an organization and account type, searching in ProductGlAccount or fallback default accounts.

methods.name: getDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Retrieves the default account ID for a specified account type and organization.

methods.name: getDescendantGlAccountClassIds
methods.description: Recursively collects the IDs of all descendant account classes of a given GL account class.

methods.name: isPaymentType
methods.description: Checks if a payment is of a specified payment type, considering the hierarchy of payment types.

methods.name: isTaxPayment
methods.description: Determines if a payment is of the 'TAX_PAYMENT' type.

methods.name: isDisbursement
methods.description: Checks if a payment is a disbursement.

methods.name: isReceipt
methods.description: Checks if a payment is a receipt.

methods.name: isAccountClass
methods.description: Determines if a GL account belongs to a specified account class.

methods.name: isDebitAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a debit account.

methods.name: isCreditAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a credit account.

methods.name: isAssetAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an asset account.

methods.name: isLiabilityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a liability account.

methods.name: isEquityAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an equity account.

methods.name: isIncomeAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an income account.

methods.name: isRevenueAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is a revenue account.

methods.name: isExpenseAccount
methods.description: Checks if a GL account is an expense account.

methods.name: isInvoiceType
methods.description: Determines if an invoice is of a specific invoice type, checking hierarchy via parent types.

methods.name: isPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is a purchase invoice.

methods.name: isSalesInvoice
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is a sales invoice.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if an invoice is a template.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfPurchaseInvoice
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for a purchase invoice based on accounting transaction entries.

methods.name: getGlExchangeRateOfOutgoingPayment
methods.description: Calculates the exchange rate for an outgoing payment based on accounting transaction entries.
